name: Precarious Thunderstone Trap
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg
description: A tripwire fastened to the gate snaps when the gate is opened, releasing a moderate thunderstone to the ground.
disable: DC 15 Thievery (trained) to remove the thunderstone or DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save to catch the falling thunderstone

generalAbilities.name: Thunderstone
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The front gate is opened

Effect A moderate thunderstone falls on the flagstones and activates, dealing (2 Splash Damage] splash damage to each creature within 10 feet of the gate. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude Saving Throw saving throw or be Deafened for 1 round. Adjacent creatures can attempt to catch the falling thunderstone (see Disable).
